//: THE OFFICES OF THE REACH (GDD §8 'the gap between office-power and house-power'). An office is granted by a Commission motion to a house whose member holds `minRank` on `track`; it is the state's, not the house's — the Admiralty commands the office fleets (the chair pays their upkeep and fuel), the Treasury draws a stipend from the chair, the Speaker weighs more in the chamber. A commission to another house strips the holder; an Admiral whose house makes war on the chair is stripped for treason; the Emperor holds every office by the throne.

offices.name: Admiral of the Reach
offices.description: Command of the Reach Squadron — the office fleet the chair pays for. The Admiral's house sails it as its own, until the Senate commissions another, or the Admiral turns it on the chair.

offices.name: Treasurer of the Reach
offices.description: The keys to the court's coffers: three credits a turn from the chair, and the Treasury sphere leans the holder's way.

offices.name: Speaker of the Senate
offices.description: The gavel: three more votes of weight, and motions cost the Speaker's house one influence less.

offices.name: Senior Consul
offices.description: The first of the two consuls (docs/REPUBLIC.md): elected every ten turns by the parties' weight, never two terms running. Four votes of weight, two credits a turn from the chair, one influence off every motion, and the veto — one motion a term struck from the docket before it is voted.

offices.name: Junior Consul
offices.description: The second of the two consuls: the runner-up at the election. Three votes of weight, a credit a turn, one influence off every motion, and the veto.
